title: Knesset 2026 quiz data, version 2
description: Produced by pipeline/export.py. The only input of web/. Formulas: docs/QUIZ_MATCHING.md; changes and the list-details format: export/V2_HANDOFF.md. v2 (2026-10-18): P = A + 0.25 V with A not centered, K = 0, P_bills, CLOSE, question order (flow, core). Written as three files loaded in order (V2_HANDOFF.md «Loading»): quiz_core.v2.json (version, generated, source_commit, flow, core, statements of the core), quiz_data.v2.json (version, generated, source_commit, params, flow, core, statements, directions, lists), quiz_bills.v2.json (version, generated, source_commit, mks, by_direction, bills). This schema describes their merge.

listId.description: Ballot letters of the list (official CEC id), e.g. "אמת".

MIN_COVERAGE.description: A list covering less of the answered weight is not ranked.

TRADE_TOP.description: Trade-offs are asked only if they change the order of this top.

TRADE_W.description: Weight multiplier of the statement chosen in a trade-off.

TRADE_CANDIDATES.description: Statements tried on each side per list.

VOTE_WEIGHT.description: Weight of a vote vs a sponsored bill in e (informational).

CLOSE.description: |p| below this: the list «has no clear position» on the statement (no for/against).

BILL_URL.description: Link to a bill on the Knesset site: replace {id} with the bill id.

MIN_EX_MKS.description: A list with fewer former MKs is shown but not ranked (customer decision 2026-10-18).

statements.description: Quiz statements in the order they are asked.

q.description: Stable statement number; gaps are allowed (removed statements).

key.description: +1: agreeing moves the direction up; -1: down.

w.description: 1, or 1/n when n statements share a direction.

interest.description: How much an ordinary voter cares (1–5, mean of two blind ratings). Used only for the order of questions.

area.description: Broad area of the statement (13 codes). Used only for the order of questions.

sim_group.description: Statements that feel like one question to a voter share a group; null = none. No two of one group are asked among the first core + clarify questions.

lists.description: All 2026 lists; this order breaks ties in the ranking.

P.description: Position relative to the average MK.

P_bills.description: Part of P from the list's own bills (the rest is votes). Decides the «side comes from votes» line.

n_votes.description: Votes on private bills on this direction (shown in explanations).

n_other.description: Votes of the list's ex-MKs on the other camp's bills on this direction (basis line, 2026-10-18).

n_names.description: Distinct bills (by name, sponsored or voted) behind the position; a clear position needs >= params.MIN_CLEAR_BILLS and n_mk >= params.MIN_CLEAR_MKS (2026-10-18).

mks.description: Candidates of 2026 lists who are former MKs (Knessets 24-25).

by_direction.description: Per quiz direction, the labeled bills in label order: [bill id, sign, role]. Order matters for ties.

name_he.description: Original Hebrew title; never translated. Render with dir="auto".

flow.description: Order of questions (pipeline/quiz_flow.py FLOW): core statements (markers of the axes, exported in `core`), then clarifying ones chosen one by one (contending pair), then trade-offs.

core.description: Number of core statements (the same for everyone).

clarify.description: Clarifying statements after the core when stop_gap is null.

core_r_max.description: Used to build the core (already applied in `core`).

core_gov_share.description: Used to build the core (already applied in `core`).

gov_r.description: Used to build the core (already applied in `core`).

clarify_top.description: Clarifying: the leader and up to clarify_top − 1 contenders are compared; the two-sided filter looks at the top clarify_top ranked lists.

stop_gap.description: Stopping rule: stop when the leader's closeness exceeds the second's by this (null = off, use `clarify`).

min_questions.description: Stopping rule: not before this many statements.

max_questions.description: Stopping rule: at most this many statements.

core_one_sided.description: false: statements on which every evaluated list with a clear position is on the same side are not in the core (2026-10-18).

core_axes.description: Used to build the core (already applied in `core`).

core_slots.description: Used to build the core (already applied in `core`).

core_min_interest.description: Used to build the core (already applied in `core`).

core_area_cap.description: Used to build the core (already applied in `core`).

interest_alpha.description: Clarifying: a candidate's score is multiplied by (interest / 5) ** interest_alpha.

pair_gap.description: Clarifying: a ranked list is a contender if its closeness is within pair_gap of the leader's.

pair_eps.description: Clarifying: weight of a contender = 1 / (leader's closeness − its closeness + pair_eps).

near_dup_r.description: Clarifying: a candidate whose |r| with a shown statement is >= near_dup_r is skipped (if anything else is left).

same_area_in_row.description: Clarifying: false = the previous question's area is skipped (if anything else is left).

sim_groups.description: Clarifying and core: no two statements of one sim_group among the shown ones.

core.description: Core statements (`q`) in the order they are asked.

votes.description: How each list's former MKs voted on the bills of a quiz direction (2026-10-19): votes[list][direction] = [[bill id, sign (+1 raises / −1 lowers the direction), «own» | «other» (the bill's camp relative to the MK), votes for, votes against], ...]. Exactly the votes behind the position (V: own camp's private bills; O: the other camp's bills). Bill name and Knesset: bills.
